name: Badges
author: Brett
description: Five banner badges in one plugin. Claude says whether Claude can build: green when one build account or more can sign in and has credits in the build orchestrator's account health sweep (the dispatcher's own check, through axf.build-dispatch@1), red when none can; tap it for which accounts are ready and why the others aren't. VPS says whether the console can see those build accounts on the host. Neither reads the VPS root `claude auth status` or .active login. axHub is the framework's live check: green only while settings come live from axHub. AmberX shows whether the phone app is connected. The usage meter shows how much of its 5-hour and weekly limits the active Claude account has used, and its drop-down lists every saved account with what is left, reset times, active marker and status. All plain reads: no tokens (the AI assistant test in settings runs only when pressed). Each badge can be shown or hidden, set to Icons only, given a label, an icon per state (ok, warning, error, off), a side and order on the banner, and a tap action (drop-down, open a screen, run a command, toggle, nothing). Removing the plugin removes only these badges; the banner, badge and clock asset types stay in the framework.
